tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sga ston rdo rje 'chang 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs pa'i gsung thor bu bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /rab 'byams pa yab sras gsum gyi bstod pa// oṃ swa sti/ kunaṃ tu bzang po gsang ba'i dam tshig mchog /bcu drug dgaṃ' ba'i mthar phyin lhan cig skyes/ /mi 'gyur yeṃ sheṃs dbyings dang ro gcig pa/ /rdo rje bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs mtshan rnams kunaṃ gyis brgyan pa'i sku/ /theg mchog gsung gi dgaṃ' ston gdul bya'i dpal/ /bde chen yeṃ sheṃs gzi byin cher 'bar ba/ /bla ma gsung gi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba kunaṃ gyi thugs rje'i cho 'phrul ltar/ /'gro rnams ji ltar dgaṃ' ba'i sna tshogs sku/ /yeṃ shesaṃ rnam par 'phrul pa bsam mi khyab/ /bla ma sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /skye ba kunaṃ tu paṇ+ḍi ta ru 'khrungs/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas legs bshad dgaṃ' ston brtson/ /yeṃ sheṃs bdud rtsis 'gro rnams tshim par mdzad/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskal pa du ma tshuṃl khriṃms phun tshogs ldan/ /rgyalaṃ ba'i bstan la mngon par brtson pa'i mthus/ /mtshaṃn mchog ldan pa mkhas mang dbus na mdzes/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kunaṃ gyi bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin cing / /mkhas rnams dgyes pa'i legs bshad dgaṃ' ston 'gyed/ /ma lus mi mthun phyogs las rnamaṃ rgyalaṃ ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ ༈ /gsung rab kunaṃ gyi snying po'i don/ /stong nyid snying rje'i dgaṃ' ston 'gyed/ /yeṃ sheṃs snang ba'i dpal dang ldan/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug zhabs la 'dud/ /tshulaṃ khrimaṃs mchog srung thos pas phyug /rgyalaṃ sras spyod pas 'gro kun smin/ /rtag tu dam pa'i mtshaṃn nyid can/ /thugs rje'i gter chen zhabs la 'dud/ /srid pa kunaṃ tu mkhas par sbyangs/ /'gro la chos kyi dgaṃ' ston 'gyed/ /nyon mongs dgra las rnamaṃ par rgyalaṃ/

/dpal dang ldan pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces dge sbyong ngag dbang legs pas bris te gsol ba btab pa dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ //bdag nyid chen po gzhung lugs rab 'byams pa kun dga' ye shes la bstod pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ rab 'byams rgyal kunaṃ 'dus pa'i zhal/ /mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis kyang / /phan bde'i dgaṃ' ston 'gyed mdzad pa/ /yeṃ shesaṃ lus can de la 'dud/ /shes bya ma lus ston pa'i gsung / /kunaṃ dgaṃ'i dpal du spros pa'i tshe/ /'jam dpal yeṃ sheṃs sems dpa' yi/ /gsung gi rnam thar rdzogs la 'dud/ /chos rnams kunaṃ gyi de bzhin nyid/ /dgaṃ' bzhi'i lam gyis gsal mdzad pa/ /bde stong zung 'jug mngon du gyur/ /yeṃ shes lnga ldan thugs la 'dud/ /mkhas kunaṃ dgaṃ' bar byed pa yi/ /lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter/ /yeṃ nas lhun gyis grub pas na/ /kun shesaṃ kun rig de la 'dud/ /'gro kunaṃ dge legs rgya mtsho yi/ /dgaṃ' mdzad 'phrin las bzang po gang / /'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /yeṃ sheṃs rol pas ston la 'dud/ /ces shākya'i dge slong ngag legs pas bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rab 'byams yab sras gsum gyi bstod pa/ bdag nyid chen po raṃb 'byamaṃs choṃs kyi rje/ /tshulaṃ khrimaṃs rnam dag bstan pa'i rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn 'dzin/ /'gro kuṃn dgaṃ' mdzad phyogs las rnamaṃ par rgyalaṃ/ /mkhan slob dam pa gsumaṃ la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di ngag dbang legs pas mdzad par grags// ༄༅/ /bdag nyid chen po gzhung lugs rab 'byams pa kun dga' ye shes kyi bstod pa rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti/ rab 'byams gzhung lugs kun la mthar son cing / /tshad med brtse bas legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed/ /zab mo rten 'byung gzigs pa'i ye shes can/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung rtogs yon tan dkyil 'khor rab rdzogs shing / /'phrin las 'od dkar drwa ba rnam par g.yo/

/thub bstan nam mkha'i dbus na lham me ba/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /phra rags nyes pa'i rdul gyis ma gos shing / /tshul khrims phung po rnam par mdzes pa'i sku/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras kyi gtso/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /byams pa'i khyon yangs snying rje'i chu dbus su/ /byang chub sems kyi rkang 'thung dbang po'i tshal/ /lhag bsam me tog dkar po'i dpal ldan pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /thun mong lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /dang po byang chub chen por thugs dam bcas/ /bar du shes bya kun la mkhas par sbyangs/ /mthar thug chos rnams kun gyi de nyid gzigs/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /mang du thos pa'i lus bzang dang ldan zhing / /yang dag rigs pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes 'bar ba/ /dri med gdams pa'i bdud rtsis nyer 'tsho ba/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /shes bya kun la mi 'jigs mkhyen pa can/ /lus can kun la ma ltar brtse ba can/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mdzad pa'i phul 'dzin pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /'chad na tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar rab snyan cing / /rtsod na rdo rje'i char ltar phas rgol 'joms/ /rtsom na rin chen phreng ltar yid 'phrog pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /ma pham klu sgrub chos kyi grags pa yi/ /gzhung lugs pad+mo'i dgongs don snying po mchog /ji bzhin 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod 'od stong can/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /kunaṃ rtog ma lus dgaṃ' bzhi'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /legs par sbyangs pas sna tshogs nyon mongs rnams/ /zag med yeṃ shesaṃ chen por gnas gyur pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /bsam gyis mi khyab gsang ba rgya mtsho'i don/ /gang gi ye shes gzigs pa'i cha tsam gyis/ /mngon du mdzad nas tshul bzhin legs 'doms pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la=

/mdo rgyu dgongs pa ji bzhin 'byed pa'i tshe/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams gus pas cho 'phrul gyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba dad pa skyed mdzad pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /mkha' la yid 'phrog 'ja' ris bkra ba dang / /sa gzhir me tog dkar po'i char chen phebs/ /sna tshogs spos dang rol mos legs mchod pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= /'jam mgon bla ma chos rje rin po che/ /'gro kunaṃ dgaṃ' mdzad yeṃ sheṃs bsam mi khyab/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po gzhung lugs rab 'byams pa/ /khyod la rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi/ /'dren mchog khyod la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /kunaṃ dgaṃ' gsung rab rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yeṃ sheṃs rgya mtsho thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /khyod zhabs pad+mo gus pas bsten pa dang / /khyod gsung bdud rtsi rtag tu myong ba dang / /thugs rje chen pos myur bar gzung du gsol/ /khyad par dge 'dun 'dus tshogs rab rgyas shing / /kun kyang thugs mthun tshul gnas khrims kyis mdzes/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya bas dus 'da' zhing / /chos mthun dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /'jam dbyangs bla ma kun dga' ye shes kyi/ /thugs bskyed smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar gsol ba'i 'dod don kun 'grub shog /ces chos rje bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas bris te gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu// ༈ //bdag kyang nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /'jam mgon bla ma gzhung lugs rab 'byams pas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der drangs nas kyang / /'od dpag med pa'i zhal mchog mthong bar mdzod/ /'dod gsol 'di 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs pas dgongs pa gshegs nyer mdzad par grags so// ༄༅/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti/ thugs rje'i gter chen 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mi yi srid bzung ba/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa/ /brtse chen kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun/ /gcig bsdus tshur mthong gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gzugs su rnam rol pa/ /'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha mi'i 'dren pa shākya'i rgyal po yis/ /kun dga' bzang po nga yi bstan 'dzin zhes/ /tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i gsung gis lung bstan pa/ /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen la= /'phags yul paṇa chen smṛ ti dz+nyā na nyid/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal du slar byon pa/ /mdo sngags gzhung brgya smra ba'i nyi ma che/ /bka' ram kun dga' ye shes la= /sde snod gsum gyi lung don 'gyed mkhas shing / /mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud phyug pas/ /mkhas btsun yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /drung chen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la= /rab 'byams gzhung lugs kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang / /legs gsung 'dul ba'i khrims ldan btsun pa'i phul/ /rnam dkar phrin las bzang po gdul bya'i dpal/ /mchog sprul kun dga' rnam rgyal la= /gang gi sku gdung grol ba bzhi ldan gyis/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i don chen mdzad pa la/ /rgya che rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las can/ /chen po sangs rgyas blo gros la= /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yis rjes su bzung / /chos srung dam can rgya mtsho bran bzhin 'khol/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /grub chen kun dga' rnam rgyal la= /mkhas grub bla ma du mas rjes su bzung / /khrims ldan smin grol gdams pa'i nor gyis phyug /skal ldan gdul bya skyong ba'i 'dren pa che/ /mkhas grub rab dkar lhun grub la= /nges gsang gdams pa'i snying po yongs bzung nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su rtse gcig sgrub mdzad pas/

/rim gnyis lam gyis ye shes mngon gyur pa/ /ngag dbang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho la= /mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su bzung / /dmigs med snying rje chen pos thugs rgyas pas/ /rtag tu gzhan phan bya bas dus 'da' ba/ /byang sems kun dga' nyi ma la= /gsang chen smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /gang thugs bum pa bzang po yongs su gtams/ /nyams dang rtogs pa mthar phyin chos kyi rje/ /mtshungs med bkra shis chos 'phel la= /dam pas byin brlabs dben pa'i nags khrod du/ /gsung ngag zab mo'i don la dbang 'byor zhing / /legs bshad rab 'byams smra la zla med pa/ /slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po la= /dpal ldan sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs khu dbon gyi/ /thugs kyi sras mchog dkar ston shākya grags/ /dus 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ /sga ston ngag dbang legs pa la= /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen phyogs brgyar spel slad du/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan la= /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mthar son mkhas pa'i rje/ /nges 'byung khrims kyi rnam dag btsun pa'i mchog /byang chub thugs mnga' bshes gnyen dam pa'i phul/ /bla ma dge 'dun bzang po la= /spros bral blo 'das lta ba'i gnad la mkhas/ /gsang chen lam gyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs/ /zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa/ /jo bo 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan la= /byams mgon gnyis pa rab 'byams chos kyi rje/ /kun dga' ye shes bstan pa gsal mdzad pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon/ /kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar mi phyed dad pas gsol btab mthus/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas/ /rtag tu dge la spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub pa'i tshe/

/zhing mchog bde ba can du skyes nas kyang / /bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog /ces rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di ni/ tshig rgyan dang mngon brjod sogs kyi sgrib g.yog med par go bde don gsal gyi tshul du shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas bris pa'i dge bas 'di nyid kha 'don byed pa rnams tshe rabs kun tu dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig gu/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi gsol 'debs gong 'og gnyis dang / 'jam rgyal gsol 'debs bcas rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang legs pa nyid kyi zhal gsung thor bu las bcug pa dang / bla ma dge 'dun bzang po'i gsol 'debs dam pa lags kyis mdzad pa dang / spros bral blo 'das sh+lau ka gcig 'di dbu mdzad bkra shis kyis bsgrigs/ mchan/ ༈ /lam 'bras slob bshad bla mchod kyi bla brgyud zhal skong ni/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i mjug tu/ 'jamaṃ pa'i dbyaṃngs dngos sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen mdzod bzung nas/ /skal ldan gdul bya skyong mdzad pa/ /rinaṃ cheṃn rdoṃ rjeṃ la phyag 'tshal/ /mkhyen brtse'i bloṃ groṃs dri med kyis/ /rtag tu gzhaṃn gyi don la dgongs/ /phaṃn bde'i 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid bzhin noraṃ buṃ la phyag 'tshal/ /sh+lau ka gnyis 'di ngag dbang legs pas bris// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng phyug gdul bya'i ngor/ /blo gros mtshungs med gzhaṃn phaṃn mtha' yas pas/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob chen po'i rnam rol gyis/ /nges gsang bstan pa'i snyiṃng poṃ spel la 'dud/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i lha lam rab yangs par/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bsil zer stong 'phro ba/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gnyen gyur de la 'dud/

/khyad par sde snod rgyud sde kun gyi bcud/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan gsung ngag rin chen la/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /dmigs med snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis/ /rgyal sras spyod tshul rgya mtsho lhur len pas/ /gangs ljongs snyigs ma'i rgud pa kun bsal nas/ /phan bde'i sgo brgya 'byed la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun bla ma la/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs mtha' dag rab rgyas nas/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni khri 'du skal bzang dgon gsar chos sde gnyis kyi grwa rigs rje bla ma nyid kyi zhal slob tu gyur pa mang pos yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas dgon gsar bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling du bris te gsol ba btab pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdzong gsar mnga' ris chos rje kun dga' 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa/ sras bcas rgyal kunaṃ dgaṃ' ba bskyed pa'i yab/ /'jaṃm pa'i dbyangaṃs dngos rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /snyan brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid na bsgrengs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ngag dbang legs pas bris pa'o// ༈ //'dzin mda'i nyi dga' rin po che la bstod pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba kunaṃ gyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan zab gsang snyan brgyud kyi/ /dgaṃ' ston 'gyed la nam yang mi g.yel ba/ /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i nyiṃ maṃr gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes ngag dbang legs pas bris pa'o// ༈ //rdzong mgo'i 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin la bstod pa/ rgyal kun 'phrin las rang gzugs nag po che/ /sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'jaṃm dpaṃl bstaṃn 'dziṃn zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/

/zhes ngag dbang legs pas bris pa'o// ༈ /thar rtse mkhan rin po che'i zhabs brtan bzhugs so// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jaṃm pa'i dbyaṃngs/ /kunaṃ dga' bzangaṃ pos yongs bzung thubaṃ pa'i bstaṃn/ /lung rtogs choṃs kyiṃ srid la dbang bsgyur ba/ /ngur smrig rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn 'dzin khyod zhabs brtan gsol/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i yal 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'bras bzang 'bum g.yos pas/ /phan bde'i 'dod rgu sbyin mdzad zhabs brtan gsol/ /dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar 'tsho bzhes shing / /bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal/ /rnam dkar phrin las gzi byin rab 'bar ba'i/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /zhes pa 'di ni shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas bris pa'o// ༄/ /thar rtse mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen po byams pa nam mkha' kun bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la bstod pa byin rlabs nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ byamaṃs dang snying rje chen po'i dpal ldan pa/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po yi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /sdom pa gsum gyi 'chi med lam yangs por/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i nyin byed bkrag 'bar zhing / /mkhas tshul gsum gyi tsha zer 'bum g.yo bas/ /thub bstan pad tshal rgyas par mdzad la 'dud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma la/ /sgo gsum gus pas rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ /khams gsum 'gro ba sred las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa 'di ni mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi zhal slob dad gus kyi lhag bsam mchog tu dkar ba/ mchog sprul rin po che kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi mas lha gos gser gyi me tog dang bcas te yang yang bskul zhing /

thar lam rnam rgyal gling gi dbu mdzad 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyis kyang nan tan chen pos bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas bris te rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gdung 'dzin cing / /theg gsum lam gyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa gcig gyur pa/ /'jam̐m dbyangam̐s chom̐s kyim̐ blom̐ grom̐s zhabs brtan gsol/ /zhes pa'ang shākya'i dge sbyong ngag dbang legs pas gsol ba btab ste bris pa'o/ /dge'o// ༈ //sde gzhung mchog sprul rin po che'i bstod pa/ 'jam̐m mgon dbyangam̐s can lha mos byin brlabs pas/ /brtse chen kunam̐ dgam̐'i ring lugs dri med pa/ /bstam̐n pa'im̐ snying po gsung ngag rin chen gyi/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyalam̐ mtshanam̐ 'dzin la 'dud/ /ces dge bshes dbyig dgas bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༄༅/ oṃ swa sti/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i yab gcig ngagaṃ dbaṃng lha/ /dram̐g shuṃl chen po'i phriṃn laṃs thogs med pas/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir mi yi srid bzung ba/ /yid bzhin riṃn chenaṃ bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sras bcas thu bo mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng po kunaṃ dgaṃ' riṃn chenaṃ dang / /mkhas dang grub pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /ngagaṃ dbaṃng kunaṃ dgaṃ' rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen dang / /dbyer med sngags 'chang bla ma yab sras la/ /mi phyed gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang thar rtse zhabs drung rdo rje 'chang byams pa nam mkha' kun bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhal 'don mdzad rgyur/ sga ston ngag dbang legs pas gsol ba btab pa'o// ༄༅/ /mchog sprul thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jaṃm pa'i dbyaṃngs/ /zab rgyas choṃs kyiṃ dga' ston spel slad du/ /bloṃ groṃs mtshungs med bshes gnyen mchog gi skur/ /yongs shar khyab bdag bla ma zhabs brtan gsol/ /legs gsung 'dul ba'i khrims kyi yu ba brtan/ /byang chub sems gnyis dar gyi lhab lhub g.yo/ /gsang chen smin grol nor bu'i tog ldan pa/ /yongs 'dzin bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog la 'dud/ /mang du thos pa'i nor gyis rgyud phyug cing / /de don bsam pa'i sgro 'dogs nang nas chod/ /rtse gcig bsgom pa'i ting 'dzin bdud rtsi yis/ /rtogs pa'i lus stobs rgyas pa de la 'dud/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes zung gi spyan dang ldan/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje 'gro kun rjes su 'dzin/ /gang gi nus pa lung rtogs bstan pa'i dpal/ /mtshungs med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'chad pa'i legs bshad skal ldan gdul bya'i dpal/ /rtsod pa'i rigs pas phas rgol log lta 'joms/ /rtsom phreng rgyal bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur pa/ /smra ba'i dbang po mchog gi zhabs la 'dud/ /snyigs dus gangs can bod kyi gdul bya la/ /dmigs med brtse ba'i thugs kyis rtag dgongs shing / /bsdu dngos bzhi yi legs mdzad mtha' yas pas/ /phan bde'i dga' ston spel mdzad zhabs la 'dud/ /de ltar rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab mthus/ /dri med thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes mchog zhabs pad rtag brtan cing / /rnam dkar phrin las rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /yul phyogs kun tu nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sogs/ /snyigs ma'i dus ltas ngan pa kun zhi nas/ /'gro kun dge bcu'i dpal la spyod pa sogs/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i bde 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /khyad par bdag cag deng nas byang chub bar/ /mgon po khyod kyis 'bral med rjes bzung zhing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i rim pa mthar phyin nas/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/ces pa 'di ni yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas sde gzhung ma'i grwa tshang bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling du bris pa dge'o// ༄༅/ /mchog sprul rin po che byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs brtan bden tshig grub pa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ byamaṃs mgon gnyis paṃ rab 'byams chos kyi rje/ /kunaṃ dgaṃ' ye shes bstaṃn pa gsal mdzad pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'iṃ dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon/ /yongs 'dzin smra ba'i nyiṃ ma zhabs brtan gsol/ /rnam dag sdom pa gsum gyis rgyud phyug cing / /rnam mang thos bsam sgom pa'i pha mthar son/ /rnam kun 'chad rtsod rtsom pas dus 'da' zhing / /rnam dkar phrin las rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /mchog gi sprul sku bskal brgyar 'tsho bzhes shing / /thugs kyi bzhed don ma lus lhun grub nas/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma srid na 'bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas re smon bden tshig snying gi dkyil nas zhus pa de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ sga ston ngag dbang legs pa'i gsung thor bu khag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
